spells/cure-critical-wounds-2378.name: Cure Critical Wounds
spells/cure-critical-wounds-2378.effectSummary: A touch channels positive energy to heal a living creature for 4d8 +1 point per caster level, maximum +20. Against undead, it deals the same amount as damage instead; an undead target can apply spell resistance and make a Will save for half damage.

provenance.role: primary DnD Tools reference text reviewed
